note: Analyst reading of the news, written from logged events. Not data. The weekly agent replaces it every week. The log is a sample: it ends with the Oct 12, 2026 launch (#2076) and many launches are missing.
headline: North Korea launched five times in October: ballistic missiles on Oct 3 and Oct 12 (#2075, #2076), submarine-launched cruise missiles on Oct 14 (#2077), about 10 short-range ballistic missiles on Oct 29 (#2082) and a tactical ballistic missile it says carried a cluster-bomb warhead on Oct 31 (#2083). No damage was reported.

The US and South Korea began the Freedom Flag air exercise at Kunsan on Oct 26, running to Nov 6 (#2080). On Oct 28 the US joined coordinated sanctions with the EU, Australia and other partners on North Korea's overseas workers, cyber activity and Russia ties (#2081).
No talks are logged. Trump said he may meet Kim on his November Asia trip, then said 'I'm not sure that anybody's asking for a meeting'; North Korea has not answered publicly (#2079).
Tension on the inter-Korean border is rising: Kim Yo Jong threatened more 'tactical strike means' along the DMZ on Oct 19 and Seoul voiced 'grave concerns' (#2078).
